visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static graphic featuring a central man pointing upwards, overlaid with bold red and yellow text. (2) A man with short black hair, wearing a blue shirt and a black cardigan over khaki pants, is seen sleeping on a bright red sofa while hugging a large tiger-patterned pillow. A small cartoon head is superimposed on the left. The background is a white room with a glass door. (3) The man wakes up, looks at the camera, and begins talking with wide, expressive hand gestures. He holds the tiger pillow tightly to his chest as he speaks. (4) A color-bar test pattern flashes briefly on the screen, followed by a cut to a close-up of a person's hands in a library, writing in an open book with a pen surrounded by stacks of white books. (5) Back on the sofa, the man continues his explanation, his facial expressions shifting from serious to animated. He gestures with his right hand while the left holds the pillow. (6) Another cut shows the close-up of hands writing and flipping pages in a book within a well-lit indoor environment. (7) Returning to the sofa, the man speaks more rapidly, tapping his hand on the pillow for emphasis. At the end, he looks shocked and the camera shakes violently as he moves out of frame as if running away.

A male voice replies sleepily, followed by a sharp electric beep corresponding to the visual test pattern. (3) The BGM enters, a high-tempo, quirky electronic track with a steady drum machine beat. The male speaker launches into an energetic, rapid-fire historical explanation with clear articulation. (4) A digital "pop" SFX punctuates the transition to the book-writing scene. The narration continues with high pitch variability. (5) As the man discusses different historical perspectives, the music remains consistent, but comedic "ding" and "slide" sound effects are added to emphasize key points. (6) The video concludes with a sharp comedic escalation in the male voice's pitch as he mentions the "boss," ending in a stylized, high-arousal scream sound effect as he flees.
